capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2019 (the page read); model years compared 2019 to 2020, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2019 spec table gross battery content.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2019 (the page read); model years compared 2019 to 2020, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2019 spec table net battery content.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia states NMC cells from Samsung SDI; no BMW page read names the chemistry.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2019 (the page read); model years compared 2019 to 2020, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2019 table: system voltage 352 V (Wikipedia: 355 V nominal); 400 V class.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2017 (the page read); model years compared 2017 to 2020, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2017 release: BMW Home Charger Connect "can precondition the vehicle battery when connected" and the battery can be warmed before starting off (no navigation trigger or DC-charge trigger described). Read as manual/scheduled only; the 2019 page mentions cabin pre-conditioning and battery warming "under certain conditions". Owner may prefer none.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2019 (the page read); model years compared 2019 to 2020, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2019 spec table: DC Combo 50 kW (all four variants).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2019 (the page read); model years compared 2019 to 2020, nothing shows a change. BMW US 2019 table: 7.4 kW (its Level 1 / Level 2 AC rows look mislabelled). Europe offers 11 kW three-phase.
